keep_playing_why: In B the BLOOM burst turned the grey valley into colour and broke inkwell nodes, and I got a 'restored' banner with a new lens twice, so I had real wins every minute or two. In A the wins were quiet (a gate opens) and most of my time was walking and carrying the same gust. B's deaths and long walk-backs annoyed me, but I still wanted one more run.
better_made_why: B has music from the start, punchy shot and kill sounds, a clear HUD with score, combo and percent restored, and a clear marker with a distance. A is the prettier storybook, but it has long silent stretches, and I got wedged on a mill deck behind planters with the camera in the character's face. B also has camera-in-the-wall moments and ink hits I could not see, so it is only slightly ahead.
furthest_A: Chapter 'Bellhollow': Wake the three windmills 2/3 (Mill of Sails and Mill of Pipes done, valve puzzle solved); on the third, ladders mill, 'Ride the grilles up the ledges', I rode grille ladders1 and ladders2 but did not finish it.
furthest_B: Chapter 1 'Lampwright's Rise': broke the first inkwell (Olive Terraces restored) and the second (Millbrook restored), 9.1% of the valley restored, score about 146k with a x7 combo, two lens upgrades (Split Lens, Arc Lens); was on the third inkwell (Vell Market) with one node broken when I died.
